# Scoring Protocol

## W1
Literal recall, literal precision, unit/token fidelity, localization, inventions.

## W2
Semantic-unit recall and precision, atomicity, evidence fidelity, qualifier preservation, negation preservation, unsupported inference.

## W3 assist
Binding/repair accuracy, harmful repair rate, defer quality, calibration.

## Error severity
E0 cosmetic
E1 minor structural
E2 meaningful omission/noise
E3 clinically material semantic distortion
E4 fabricated or source-contradictory claim

All metrics must report numerator/denominator and per-stratum results.
